The study, led by the Cancer Immunotherapy Research Group, a joint research group of the Hospital del Mar Research Institute, the Spanish National Cancer Research Centre (CNIO) and the Hospital 12 de Octubre Research Institute (i+12), has been published in the journal Advanced Science.

To carry out the study, the researchers analysed molecular data from 10,937 patients with biliary tract cancer. As Dr Clara Montagut, head of the Medical Oncology Section at Hospital del Mar and deputy director of HMRIB, explains, "one of the study's key strengths is that it includes the largest international cohort analysed to date, giving the findings considerable clinical validity.
